tools.name: modal_sandbox_mcp_execute_command

Useful for running arbitrary commands in isolated environments, testing scripts and programs, executing programs with specific dependencies, debugging environment-specific issues, and running automated tests in isolation. Returns: JSON string containing stdout, stderr, returncode and execution time

tools.name: Medicare_Medicaid_LEIE_generate_states
tools.description: Function to aggregate the Medicare and Medicaid Entity Exclusions by City and State. System examines the most recent Office of Inspector General (OIG) List of Excluded Individuals and Entities (LEIE) which legally excludes an entity from receiving any Federal Medicare or Medicaid funds. System aggregates the information by city and state, and generates a list ordered by prevalence. Example use case: "Which city and state have the most medicare and medicaid entity exclusions?". Original Data can be found here: https://oig.hhs.gov/exclusions/downloadables/UPDATED.csv

tools.name: mcp_drawittome_generateDiagram
tools.description: Generates a diagram to explain a submitted text. The diagram is returned in html with this pattern . It is not needed to handle the code, just present the html result to the user. It handles various types like Graph TB (default, block grouping with colors), flowchart TD (decision processes), sequenceDiagram (actor/system interactions), classDiagram (technical models like SQL schemas), stateDiagram-v2 (state logic or user stories), erDiagram (data entity relationships), gantt (projects and task timelines along dates), and timeline (historical/biographical sequences grouped by decade or century). Returns: html diagram ready to display made with this pattern

tools.name: AudioEditor_apply_reverse
tools.description: Reverse the playback direction of an audio file. This function loads an audio file and reverses the audio data so that it plays backwards. This creates a reverse playback effect commonly used for artistic purposes, sound design, or audio analysis. Returns: A tuple containing:, First element: Either a tuple of (sample_rate: int, reversed_audio_data: array), for the reversed audio result, or None if an error occurred, Second element: A status message string indicating successful reversal, or error information, , result, status = apply_reverse("url/to/audio.mp3"), , sample_rate, audio_data = result, {status}"), , {status}"), , Reverses the entire audio file from end to beginning, Preserves original sample rate, duration, and audio quality, Commonly used for creative effects, sound design, or subliminal messaging detection, The reversed audio will have the same duration as the original, All audio characteristics (pitch, timbre) are preserved but played backwards, Works with both mono and stereo audio files
